workload.note: Season ended Week 4 (vs LAC) due to torn ACL. Partial-season data points found: Week 2 vs DAL line was 9 rec/167 yds/2 TD; was 'on pace for 1,422 yards' before injury; in the injury game (Wk4) he had 3 rec/20 yds on 23 of 69 snaps. Full cumulative season totals not verified.

contract.note: 4-year rookie contract worth $29.2M with $18M signing bonus, signed after being drafted 6th overall (LSU) in 2024. No extension reported as of this research pass; still under rookie deal.

scheme.note: Giants hired John Harbaugh as head coach in January 2026 (replacing Brian Daboll), a full coaching-staff change. Matt Nagy is the offensive coordinator per Giants.com staff announcement. New play-calling scheme for 2026, first year under Harbaugh/Nagy.

notes: Drafted 6th overall in 2024 by NYG out of LSU.
Nabers is expected to be the clear No. 1 WR for QB Jaxson Dart if healthy (Yahoo Giants 2026 WR breakdown, 2026-07-17).

injury.status: Recovering from torn ACL suffered Week 4, 2025 (vs. Chargers); also had damaged meniscus and underwent a scar-tissue cleanup procedure in spring 2026. As of mid-July 2026, reported to be approximately 70-80% through rehab and had missed spring practices. HC John Harbaugh described it as 'not a simple knee' and said he hopes Nabers works into camp 'one way or another,' with camp participation possible but full readiness for season start uncertain.

camp.quote: He's making really good progress right now. I'm very hopeful that he'll be back soon.
